2. Scope of Services

FTR delivers enterprise technology solutions spanning:

  • IT Infrastructure & Sourcing: Supply of workstations, enterprise servers, switching gear, and genuine OEM computing hardware.
  • Systems Integration: Network cabling, multi-vendor hardware-software deployment, operating system setups, and architectural consulting.
  • Facility Management Services (FMS): Dedicated on-site technicians, surveillance maintenance, and helpdesk management.
  • Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC): Scheduled preventive checks, SLA-backed breakdown repairs, and components replacement according to executed master service agreements (MSAs).
